name: agent-skill-ultimate-coding
description: Understand, design, build, verify and report like a careful senior engineer: must-follow safety rules, task sizing, and proof before calling work done.

checklist.title: Checklist above the input
checklist.description: Claude's checklist for the task, drawn above the input while it works and ticked item by item. Recommended: keep it on. Off: Claude uses its own task list if the session has one, or a numbered list in its reply.

checklistTimer.title: Timer on the checklist
checklistTimer.description: A count-up timer on the checklist: the task's total time in its header, and how long each item took. Wall-clock time, waits included.
